captions.detailed: A compact laboratory monocular microscope featuring a black rectangular base, a beige upright arm, and a black rectangular stage supported by a vertical column. On the stage, a light grey slide carriage translates prismatically from left to right, holding a transparent blue glass slide. The monocular head, equipped with a cylindrical objective and eyepiece, slides prismatically up and down along vertical metal guides on the arm, controlled by rotating black focus knobs on a shared horizontal shaft.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a laboratory monocular microscope with a rectangular base, a vertical arm, a specimen stage, and a monocular head. Incorporate a prismatic joint for the slide carriage translating horizontally on the stage, a prismatic joint for the head carriage translating vertically on the arm, and a continuous rotational joint for the dual focus knobs on their shared horizontal shaft.
captions.factory: Construct the microscope by creating a base link using a box primitive, an upright arm, and a stage assembly. For the slide carriage, model a flat slider and a glass slide using boxes, and attach it to the stage with a prismatic joint along the X-axis. Build the monocular head assembly using cylinders for the objective lens and eyepiece, mounted on a sliding carriage block that translates vertically via a prismatic joint on the arm's Z-axis. Finally, define a horizontal cylinder for the focus shaft with cylindrical knobs on each end, and connect it to the arm with a continuous rotational joint.
